items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: BRIEF S3 items 1-7 implemented: ordered-dir matcher with first-owner and warnings, resolve-before-write effective profile, provenance-keyed CI/CodeQL, run-config writers, minor snapshot bump, consumer audit.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown/invalid/drifted profiles abort generate with the resolver exit code and nothing written; a missing bundled dir is an error; discovery skips bad candidates with warnings, including non-object stack.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Names validated by the resolver; containment via list_profiles; shadows and warnings surfaced in the adopt result; no commands are run by adopt.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Three new test files plus fixture update; assertions on source, reason codes, exit codes and the written tree; cache-layout subprocess probes for adopt and project.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One list_profiles pass per analysis and one resolve per generate.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Glue in adopt_profile.py and project profile_check.py; generate_adoption_artifacts.py is 696 lines against 697 before (cap 716).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Snapshot producer/consumer round-trip probed with real analyze then generate CLIs; the probe found a noisy missing-user-dir warning, fixed and re-probed.
